summary: Precision Biosciences filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a follow-on underwritten offering of 10,235,077 common shares plus pre-funded warrants for 5,893,964 shares, priced at $7.75 per share (warrants $7.749995), grossing roughly $125.0 million and netting about $117.5 million before expenses. TD Cowen and Guggenheim Securities are underwriters; the offering is priced at a discount to the $8.12 last sale on November 4, 2026, with closing expected November 6, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and any warrant overhang.
